name: lygo-ops-detector labeled discourse suite
notes: Public calibration set. Label=1 texts are multi-signal clusters so the operational bar (evasion>0.70 OR ops>=0.65) is meaningfully testable. Short single-channel bait is covered by Flame Ward half-truth/saturation channels + calibration threshold. Labels = signal presence, not identity judgments.
